title: Informed consent
intro: Before your first session we need to know about your health.

health.heading: Health status
health.intro: Please state whether you currently have, or have had, any of the following conditions. Where applicable, say which one and since when.

detailMissing: Please add the details when the answer is yes.

fields.pregnancyDetail: Weeks of pregnancy / date of birth
fields.limbSwelling: Sudden swelling, pain or redness in a limb
fields.allergies: Allergies, skin conditions or reaction to cosmetics
fields.avoidZone: Area you would rather avoid or that needs special care

treatment.heading: Consent to treatment
treatment.body: I declare that the information provided is correct and that I will report any relevant change before future sessions. I have been informed about the requested service, its wellness purpose, possible temporary discomfort and its limitations. I understand that it does not replace medical care and that I may ask to stop the treatment at any time. I voluntarily consent to it being carried out.

healthData.heading: Personal and health data
healthData.accept: I expressly consent to the processing of the health data provided in order to assess the suitability and safety of the service, according to the available privacy information.
healthData.controller: Controller: Yusleidy Caridad Jiménez Pérez (Essentia Social Wellness Club), Calle Arure 29, San Isidro, 38611 Santa Cruz de Tenerife · info@essentiawellnessclub.com

image.heading: Image consent (optional and independent)
image.body: I authorise photographs of the treated area to document its progress, with no public disclosure. Any publication or promotional use will require a specific additional authorisation.

already: This consent has already been signed.

errors.invalid: Please check the details and try again.
errors.tooLarge: The signature is too large. Clear it and sign again.
errors.alreadySigned: This consent has already been signed.
errors.generic: We could not save the consent. Please try again.
